name: A second viewport for the 3D asset preview
body:
# 3D preview

The asset panel's preview is a second `<viewport renderer="LanternPreview">`: the backend owns a `PreviewScene`
(one mesh, its own orbit camera, a turntable when idle) rendered with the same `GpuRenderer`. Shows the selected
template, model or texture (on a cube). Proves the viewport primitive can be used more than once in an app.

comments.text: Done 2026-10-27. <viewport renderer="preview"> in AssetBrowser.chaos, rendered by lantern_editor_render_preview as a turntable of the selected template.
